title: Fix Mission Control AI Signal showing Connect ChatGPT on initial load when ChatGPT is globally connected
goal: When ChatGPT OAuth is globally connected (settings ai.provider=chatgpt_oauth and GET /api/v1/auth/chatgpt/status returns connected status), the AI Signal panel initial state must show 'Select a run to see AI Signal insights' instead of 'Connect ChatGPT in Settings'. Check the global ChatGPT connection status in the boot sequence (already fetched via apiOrNull /api/v1/auth/me or auth status), store result in state, and use it in the AI panel render when no run is selected.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Mission Control AI Signal panel shows 'Connect ChatGPT in Settings' on the initial page load before any run is selected. ChatGPT IS connected (google-oauth2, gpt-5.4). After selecting the NFIR Live Acceptance run the panel correctly shows 'CHATGPT CONNECTED / REVIEW READY / 3 ENTRIES'. The initial state message is wrong and sends operators into Settings unnecessarily.
